nodes.title: PJ二采分段精修采样器 (高清无损/防爆显存)

widgets_values:
Product reference images: images 1, images 2，images 3，images 4，images 5
<Subject 1>: Fully Preserved (fully_preserved) — Synthesize the provided [Reference Image 1], [Reference Image 2], and [Reference Image 3] to reconstruct a unified product design, with a focus on capturing its iconic form, proportions, and volume.
<Video 1> is the uploaded source video. The replacement target is the original shoe product being showcased throughout this video, across all its appearances.
<Audio 1> is the original soundtrack of <Video 1>, if present.

summary:
[video editing + reference generation + audio reuse] The target video is an edited version of <Video 1>. Replace the showcased shoe product with <Subject 1> throughout the original timeline. The product references determine the replacement shoes' appearance and geometry. Preserve the original scene, actions, camera movements, editing, and audio, with local adjustments necessary to accommodate the replacement product.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1>: fully_preserved - reproduce one consistent product design using all listed reference views, prioritizing its characteristic shape, proportions, and volume.
<Video 1>: partially_preserved - replace the target footwear and adapt its immediate contact relationships, occlusions, shadows, and reflections as necessary. Preserve the remaining content and temporal structure.
<Audio 1>: fully_copy - preserve the complete original soundtrack unchanged. If the source is silent, preserve silence.

detailed_description:
Preserve the original visual style, lighting, and scene continuity of <Video 1>.

[Shot 1] Follow the original opening composition, with any visible target footwear already replaced by <Subject 1>. Continue the replacement through every original shot and every appearance of the target footwear until the final frame.The shoes being displayed in the character's hands and the shoes the character is wearing need to be replaced.

Treat all listed product images as complementary views of the same shoe design. Use the relevant details for each viewing angle. Maintain consistent construction, materials, colors, branding, and geometry across movement, rotation, cuts, and reappearance after occlusion. Reference-image count does not determine the number of shoes in the output.

The reference product takes priority over the original footwear's geometry. Reconstruct the replacement shoes according to the reference design, including their overall volume, toe width, upper height, sole thickness, and length-to-width proportions.

Do not constrain the replacement to the original shoes' bounding boxes, outlines, dimensions, or occupied screen areas. Allow the replacement to occupy more or less space in the frame as required by its design. Do not stretch, flatten, compress, or reshape the reference product to fit the original footwear.

Determine a natural scene scale using surrounding feet, hands, objects, the ground plane, and camera perspective. Preserve the reference product's characteristic proportions and bulk at that scale. Do not infer physical size from how large the shoes appear within the reference photographs.

Preserve the original number of shoes, correct left-right identity, action timing, movement paths, and interaction intent. Use the original placement and interactions as spatial anchors rather than fixed shape or size constraints. Adapt local contact points and occlusions to the replacement geometry. Make only the minimal necessary adjustments to nearby fingers, clothing, or foot contact while preserving the original poses and actions.

Match perspective, lighting, focus, and motion blur. Update contact shadows and reflections for the new geometry. Naturally reconstruct surrounding areas exposed by a smaller or lower replacement, and correctly occlude areas covered by a larger or taller replacement.

Preserve all other subjects, objects, backgrounds, unrelated footwear, subtitles, text, and existing overlays. Retain the original camera movement, framing, shot order, transitions, playback speed, and total duration.

Use the reference images only to define the replacement product. Do not transfer their backgrounds or product arrangements into the video. Do not add extra shoes, new shots, or still-image endings.

overall_soundscape:
Copy the original dialogue, ambience, and sound effects from <Audio 1> with unchanged timing and volume. Preserve existing silence. Add no new audio.

non_diegetic_music:
Copy the original background music from <Audio 1> unchanged. If none is present, add none.
